about: The naming registry for the ClearedStack platform. One entry per component: its canonical name, the identifier it replaced, what it is responsible for, its boundaries, its repository, its container image and what it depends on. Manifests, pipelines and documentation should take names from this file.

components.name: Conn
components.responsibility: Shows the catalog, the guides and the state of the factory to anyone, and takes in edit proposals.
interfaces: Public HTTPS: the only way in from outside
Reads Logbook's public views with a read-only role
Receives the live update stream from Muster and sends it edit proposals

components.name: Muster
components.responsibility: Hands out work to the workers, records every result and change of state, and receives edit proposals.
interfaces: Worker calls over cluster-private HTTP: lease, heartbeat, complete, fail, needs_subtool
Reads and writes Logbook's working records; the only service that does
Live update stream and edit-proposal intake for Conn
Receives health reports from Bosun

components.name: Logbook
components.responsibility: Keeps the record of every item, decision and proposal, and the public views of that record.
interfaces: Working records (the core schema): read and written by Muster only
Public views (the pub schema): read-only, for Conn
components.image: postgres:17-alpine (upstream PostgreSQL; Logbook is the schema and ledger on top)

components.name: Plainforge
components.responsibility: Holds the primary copy of every repository, announces each change and mirrors code outward.
interfaces: Git over HTTP and SSH, inside the cluster only
Push notifications to Slipway
Outbound mirror of code to GitHub
Commits from Foghorn, Slipway and Jig; reads by Bosun

components.name: Stow
components.responsibility: Keeps built images inside the cluster, with recent versions ready for rollback.
interfaces: Standard OCI registry API, inside the cluster only
Pushes from Slipway's build jobs
Pulls by the cluster's container runtime when Bosun deploys

components.name: Slipway
components.responsibility: Tests, builds and signs an image for every change.
interfaces: Receives push notifications from Plainforge
Pushes signed images to Stow
Writes the new image digest back to Plainforge

components.name: Bosun
components.responsibility: Deploys what was built, keeps it in its intended state and reports its health with cluster details removed.
interfaces: Kubernetes API, using server-side apply
Reads manifests from Plainforge and image digests from Stow
Sends cleaned health reports to Muster

components.name: Trawl
components.responsibility: Finds candidate tools and records each one exactly once.
interfaces: Leases work from Muster over cluster-private HTTP
Reads public sources: SAM.gov notices, GitHub issues, scheduled site sweeps and the site's own form

components.name: Spyglass
components.responsibility: Reads a candidate's public pages and writes down what job it does, copying nothing.
interfaces: Leases work from Muster over cluster-private HTTP
Fetches public pages over HTTPS, and starts a temporary browser job when a page needs one

components.name: Assay
components.responsibility: Screens each candidate against the knockout gates and scores it on the rubric.
interfaces: Leases observed records from Muster
Returns a pass or fail on each gate, a score and a recommendation

components.name: Gavel
components.responsibility: Holds scored candidates and edit proposals until a person decides.
interfaces: Leases scored candidates and pending proposals from Muster
Presents them to the owner and records the decision, with a reason for any override

components.name: Waybill
components.responsibility: Credits where an idea came from and writes the specification a tool is built from.
interfaces: Leases approved items from Muster
Emits the credit note and the build specification

components.name: Jig
components.responsibility: Generates a tool's repository from its specification and a fixed template.
interfaces: Leases build specifications from Muster
Commits the generated repository to Plainforge

components.name: Shakedown
components.responsibility: Checks a built tool against the five listing conditions before it can be listed.
interfaces: Leases built tools from Muster
Returns a pass or fail on each of the five conditions

components.name: Gazette
components.responsibility: Publishes, links, merges and retires catalog entries.
interfaces: Leases verified, linked, merged and retired items from Muster
Writes catalog entries to the hub repository in Plainforge

components.name: Dogwatch
components.responsibility: Watches official sources, live tools and linked tools for change, and reopens whatever is affected.
interfaces: Leases scheduled checks from Muster
Fetches the Federal Register, the eCFR and NIST's publications, and checks linked and live tools

components.name: Foghorn
components.responsibility: Turns failures, paused items and approved edits into one piece of work in the repository that owns the fix.
interfaces: Leases routing work from Muster
Commits changes and opens tasks in Plainforge
Sends owner alerts to a configured webhook
Feeds the live update stream through Muster
